name: email-transfer-station-pages
description: Cloudflare Pages frontend and same-origin Worker proxy for Email Transfer Station

scripts.check: node --check functions/_middleware.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const f of ['_headers','_routes.json']) { const p='../frontend/dist/'+f; if (!fs.existsSync(p)) throw new Error('Missing '+p); } JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('../frontend/dist/_routes.json','utf8'));"
scripts.deploy: corepack pnpm run build && wrangler pages deploy --branch production
